author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Using AI well is not about writing fancy prompts or installing cool skills, it is not even about the harness engineering nor which models has the highest benchmark score this week.

It is about how you use AI to organize data into information, information into knowledge, knowledge into insight, insight into wisdom, and stuff it all into your meat brain.

In investing, there is an old saying, "you can't make money outside of your understanding of the market, the market will trim it back down in a long term"

In using AI, it also applies.
